notes: Early-stage evaluation of Redwood for internal IT/helpdesk chatbot. Team: Product lead (Maya Lopez), Eng lead (Samir Rao), IT ops (J. Chen), Security (A. Morales). Plan: start with Hosted API for fast demo/POC, then migrate to Dedicated (reserved GPUs + VPC) if latency/throughput and audit needs satisfied. Must-haves: streaming responses + tool-calling, p95 latency target <200ms for conversational flows, audit logs + retention controls, SSO/SAML and KMS integrations. Cost-sensitive — want guidance on batching/quantization to reduce per-token spend. Quote from product: "need responses under 200ms for agent flows; anything slower breaks UX." Security asked for SOC2-like controls and a completed security questionnaire. Engineering concerned about KV cache behavior across sessions and fallback model behavior during capacity spikes.

poc_details: Hosted API POC: simulated 50 concurrent internal agents, primary flow is ticket creation + context retrieval. Tested models: base-open-compat (low-latency), larger-context variant for complex triage. Streaming enabled via SDK, tool-calling integrated to JIRA API for create/lookup. Observed metrics: p50 ~60ms, p95 ~180-220ms depending on sequence length and model variant; best results when using small-model with prefix KV caching. Autoscaling not evaluated in Hosted POC. Need Dedicated trial to validate steady-state p95 <200ms at sustained throughput. Also validating audit log format and retention export for SIEM ingestion.
pricing_discussion: Customer expects mid-market pricing; exploring transition path: start Hosted (pay-as-you-go + free credits) -> move to Dedicated 6-month reserved commit. Asking for discount tiers for committed ARR $25-75k. Wants clear mapping of units (tokens vs requests) and cost reduction levers (batching, quantization). Finance flagged cap on monthly spend during POC.
next_steps_and_blockers: Next steps: 1) Run Dedicated demo with a small reserved pool to validate p95 at sustained load (AE to coordinate scheduling with infra). 2) Redwood SE to produce POC latency report + recommended model/quantization profile. 3) Legal to complete DPA + sign-off on retention controls. 4) Pricing term draft for 6-month commit. Blockers: security sign-off timeline (waiting on SOC2/attestation details), clarify data residency for logs, finalizing committed spend threshold.
